title: Simple distillation
caption: The vapour leaving the flask passes the thermometer bulb, placed level with the side arm so it reads the temperature of the vapour that is distilling, then condenses in a sloping condenser and is collected. Water enters the lower end of the condenser.
alt: A heated flask, a still head with a thermometer bulb at the side arm, a sloping condenser with water in at the lower end, and a collecting flask.
description: Thermometer bulb level with the side arm.
Condenser: water in at the lower end, out at the upper end.
